title: Sync
purpose: Say truthfully what has reached the server, through offline queues, conflicts and expiring sessions.
useWhen: Work is saved continuously or optimistically, may go offline, or may be edited by two people at once.
avoidWhen: Forms saved once with an explicit button; use the edit-record contract.
alternatives: Use the edit-record contract for explicit saves, and SyncIndicator alone for a single autosaving document.
requiredInputs: conflict detection with both versions and the other author
session expiry time and a way to extend it
transitions: saved → pending on a change → saved when acknowledged, or failed with Retry
pending → offline-queued when the connection drops
offline-queued → replaying → saved when it returns
pending → conflict when another version arrived → resolved by keep mine, theirs or both
session-expiring → saved on Stay signed in, or session-expired keeping the draft
applicability: Autosaving, optimistic or local-first work, and sessions that expire.
exceptions: Require only states supported by the application; online-only apps skip the offline states but still never claim unacknowledged work is saved.
